name: Zacama
description: Elder dinosaur who killed the compleated Etali.

description_citations.text: "Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Now able to planeswalk, Huatli returns home riding Zacama, and the emperor lets her use the title Warrior-Poet.
timeline.quote: Huatli first returned home, using the Elder Dinosaur Zacama as a mount

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli arrives in Pachatupa riding the elder dinosaur Zacama.
timeline.quote: Zacama was not intelligent per se, but she was somehow aware that she had a name

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Zacama, the last and greatest elder, arrives and her roar disintegrates the Phyrexian front ranks.
timeline.quote: Zacama, the final and greatest of the elders, loomed up from the shadows

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Zacama kills the turned Etali by tearing off his head.
timeline.quote: Zacama tore his head from his body, then flung it into the city below.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Zacama acknowledges Huatli before departing, and the sun breaks through over Orazca.
timeline.quote: Dawn had arrived: the day, though not yet won, was here.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire, pirates and the Legion of Dusk unite and Zacama fells Etali, saving Ixalan from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Etali was finally felled by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zacama fells the compleated dinosaur Etali on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Etali was finally felled by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli leads auxiliaries and dinosaurs to call the elder dinosaurs; compleated Etali is killed by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa, and the Phyrexians flee.
timeline.quote: was killed by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa
